name: echo countdown
description: Proposal, a countdown, 40 cell lattice (12 px cells, the creature at 2x moved down under a dark split flap card with a big cream block digit): on 3 it looks up at the card and blinks, the card flips to 2 and it crouches a row with its eyes narrowed and an antenna ping, flips to 1 and it crouches deeper with its eyes squeezed shut and shivers, then the card bursts into eight gold rays and sparkles and the creature hops with both arms straight up, eyes shut happy, lands in a crouch, stands happy while the sparkles fade and blinks, and a blank card comes back and flips to 3; judge whether the digits read at a glance and are the only thing written, whether the brace reads as bracing, whether the hop reads as joy, and whether it is still this creature.
